understanding the role of stress in the development of obesity in women of reproductive age.
understanding the relationship between parenting stress and postpartum weight.
the development of effective interventions to prevent the development of obesity in women of reproductive age, and to reduce the risk of overweight in the offspring.

stress in the first year of motherhood is related to weight retention.
